_readme: The DECLARED asset slots the gap census cannot discover on its own, plus refinements to the ones it can.
Sound slots are auto-discovered from the C# (every FMODUnity.EventReference field), because the
project's convention makes every one of them a slot by construction. Visual and art slots are NOT
auto-discoverable: a null GameObject or Sprite field is usually optional, and only a human can say
which ones a discipline is expected to fill. So they are declared here, one row each, and the census
reports exactly what this file claims and nothing more.
Adding a slot here is how a NEW asset need becomes a tracked task without anyone remembering to file
class          the C# type that declares the field (the file name under Assets/_Scripts)
field          the serialized field name, exactly as Unity writes it
kind           sound | vfx | art2d | video | model
discipline     who fills it - matches the Notion 'Type' options where one applies
group          tasks are grouped by this; one group becomes one task
required_when  sibling key/value that must hold for the slot to be required at all
label          human phrasing for the task line
script         the .cs file that declares a nested [Serializable] holder, when it differs from 'class'
waivers: a slot that is deliberately unfilled, WITH the reason. Use it instead of the baseline whenever somebody has actually decided; the baseline only records that a gap exists.

slots.label: Per-species creature loop (only required when the variant overrides the prefab emitter)
slots._note: the field is declared on the nested [Serializable] FaunaVariantTuning inside FaunaConfigurationSO.cs; the census attributes a nested field to the NESTED class, and the asset carries it at a deeper indent

slots.label: Skim particle burst for this prism kind (SkimFxRunner instantiates it; an empty slot is silent by design, not broken)

no_slot_expectations.rule: CLAUDE.md: every ship ability gets its own dedicated EventReference field. This executor declares no audio surface at all, so its ability is silent and nothing in the inspector says so.
